mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmis_data_export_audit ( user_id, username, export_module, export_action, biz_type, row_count, file_name, file_size, export_format, query_summary, trace_id, client_ip, tenant_id, exported_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{exportModule}, #{exportAction}, #{bizType}, #{rowCount}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{exportFormat}, #{querySummary}, #{traceId}, #{clientIp}, #{tenantId}, #{exportedAt}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, export_module, export_action, biz_type, row_count, file_name, file_size, export_format, query_summary, trace_id, client_ip, tenant_id, exported_at, created_at FROM pmis_data_export_audit WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY exported_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
